Hello !
After months of development I am both proud and nervous to finally announce SUKABLAT! to the public. It's been a while now since i had the idea to create a platform for passionate CSGO players to challenge their friends or random people to a 1v1 for skins. We still have a long way to go, but we are confident that we can achieve everything we need to make you feel secure and comfortable while using SUKABLAT!

SUKABLAT??
As stated above, we are offering a service on which you can find an opponent to play against for skins. Currently you are able to either play with random opponents or a friend of yours. We already implemented many features to make the service as good as possible. We have planned to implement many more features in the future, like an own anti-cheat system or team based matches.

We also want to host whole tournaments in the future, with great prizes for the winner / the winning team.

Our service is fully functional at the moment, but we have to make a beta phase to stress test the system. This is a huge project and it's still early in development, we have to test it under heavy load.

To make you familiar with the process of finding an opponent to winning a game, I want you to watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ayLrgofIZ-A

The idea..

...SUKABLAT! was created because I always dreamed to win big on CSGO gambling sites, who doesn't? The problem is, if your inventory value is below $ 100 you just dont have a realistic chance. Besides that, it's purely random and heavily based on luck. We want to provide a service for everyone who wants to earn skins by just playing better than his opponent. Other gambling services are taken over by streamers and other people with a huge inventory, as a "normal" CSGO player you dont have the amount of items needed to have a realistic chance to win.

What else?

To play with strangers we built a CSGO like queue system which will match you against opponents the same rank. To use our queue system you have to set you rank first, which is done by adding one of our bots to your steam friendlist while having csgo opened. The bot will then automatically fetch your rank and update it.

To prevent booster, smurfs and co. you can only enter the queue if you have 70 ranked wins or above. In addition to that we made your rank expire. If your rank is older than 15 days you have to update it. Furthermore we are reviewing every single game before sending out items, just to make sure no one played unfair. In case we spot a cheater on a demo, we will lock him out of the website and report him to valve. You will obviously get your items back.

In case you are worried about your items, we keep track of every offer made and we take several security measures to protect them. Just to tell some: If your opponent declines the trade offer, you will get your items back almost immediately. Trade offers will get canceled and items will be returned if they arent accepted after a given amount of time and if for any reason your game does not start or finish, you will also receive your items back.

To be honest, we still have many things on our todo list, one of them being an anti-cheat system superior to vac. Besides that, we want to give you the opportunity to challenge other teams for skins in a 5v5 environment. We also want to host team or single player based tournaments with great prizes for the winner.

But features like this can only be implemented after we have grown enough.

If you want to apply for the beta visit SUKABLAT! and use the contact form to leave me a nice message. Tell me a good joke if you want. You need to specify your correct steamid64 , otherwise i can't add you as a beta member. You will receive an email if you are added.

I will slowly increase the number of beta participants. If you encounter an error please let me know. Use the contact form and tell me as detailed as possible what happened. Thank you!

You are still reading? Well thank you. Thanks for being a part of SUKABLAT!.
See you soon!
